Veterans Benefits: Connecticut does not tax federally taxed military retired pay, exempts qualifying military disability and survivor benefits, provides wartime veteran property-tax exemptions with additional income/disability-based relief, and requires municipalities to provide a full property-tax exemption for veterans with a total and permanent service-connected VA disability rating.

Description: Stratford is a coastal suburban town on Long Island Sound at the mouth of the Housatonic River, best known as the historic headquarters and manufacturing home of Sikorsky Aircraft. It offers waterfront parks, boating access, a local Walmart, convenient access to the West Haven VA Medical Center, low reported crime, and a liberal voting profile.
